description: punit's conformance scope beyond the oracle's family-mandatory tier. Extend-only: suites listed here are additional obligations; nothing here can subtract from the manifest's familyMandatory roster. These are the optional suites of features punit implements: the regression cutoff without a verdict and the threshold-first inversion, risk-driven sizing, the nearest-rank percentile and its emission minimums, and explicit latency requirements. A suite absent from both tiers is reported as unaddressed by every conformance run, never silently skipped.
